annotations.title: Apply a paragraph style to a whole frame

description: Apply a paragraph style (Absatzformat) to every paragraph of a text frame. By default (clear_overrides true) local formatting and character styles are cleared first, so the print matches the style, not only its name; with clear_overrides false deliberate local bold or italic stays, and so does every stray override. For a threaded frame only the paragraphs touching this frame are formatted – use apply_paragraph_style_to_range over the whole story (0 to story_length from get_frame_text) for the rest. Returns frame_id, style_applied, affected_paragraphs, overrides_cleared and threaded. Stories managed by an editorial workflow (InCopy) that are not checked out here (lock_state checked_in_story, locked_story, missing_lock_state or mixed_lock_state) are refused before anything is written: invalid_state with details.code "story_locked" (details: frame_id, story_id, lock_state, managed_file) – check the story out in the editorial system or in InCopy first.

clear_overrides.description: Clear local character formatting and character styles first. Default true.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.
